title: The rule of three
description:
If a class needs a hand-written **destructor**, it almost certainly needs a hand-written **copy constructor** and **copy assignment operator** too. That is the rule of three. Write all three for a growable array of `int`.

`IntArray`:

- `explicit IntArray(std::size_t size)`: that many elements, all 0.
- destructor, copy constructor, copy assignment (safe against self-assignment).
- `int& operator[](std::size_t)` and a const version.
- `std::size_t size() const`.
- `void resize(std::size_t newSize)`: keeps the elements that still fit, new elements are 0.
lessonTitle: RAII and the Rule of Three
